hook.en: The female system does more than make eggs: it receives sperm, hosts fertilisation, nurtures the foetus and feeds the newborn.
hook.kn: ಸ್ತ್ರೀ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಅಂಡಾಣು ತಯಾರಿಸುವುದಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲ; ನಿಷೇಚನ, ಭ್ರೂಣದ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಶಿಶುವಿನ ಪೋಷಣೆಗೂ ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: The female system does more than make eggs: it receives sperm, hosts fertilisation, nurtures the foetus and feeds the newborn.
narration.kn: ಸ್ತ್ರೀ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಅಂಡಾಣು ತಯಾರಿಸುವುದಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲ; ನಿಷೇಚನ, ಭ್ರೂಣದ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಶಿಶುವಿನ ಪೋಷಣೆಗೂ ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: The ovaries are the primary female sex organs, each 2–4 cm long; they produce ova and hormones. Each oviduct (fallopian tube) has a funnel-shaped infundibulum with finger-like fimbriae that collect the ovum, a wider ampulla and a narrow isthmus that joins the uterus. The uterus wall has three layers: the outer perimetrium, the thick muscular myometrium that contracts during delivery, and the inner glandular endometrium that changes during the menstrual cycle. The cervix opens into the vagina; together they form the birth canal.
body.kn: ಅಂಡಾಶಯಗಳು ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಸ್ತ್ರೀ ಲೈಂಗಿಕ ಅಂಗಗಳು. ಅಂಡನಾಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಇನ್‌ಫಂಡಿಬುಲಮ್, ಆಂಪುಲ್ಲಾ ಮತ್ತು ಇಸ್ತ್ಮಸ್ ಭಾಗಗಳಿವೆ. ಗರ್ಭಾಶಯದ ಗೋಡೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪೆರಿಮೆಟ್ರಿಯಮ್, ಮಯೋಮೆಟ್ರಿಯಮ್ ಮತ್ತು ಎಂಡೋಮೆಟ್ರಿಯಮ್ ಪದರಗಳಿವೆ.

say.en: The uterus sits in the middle, with an oviduct on each side ending near an ovary, and the cervix opening into the vagina below.
The oviduct has the infundibulum with finger-like fimbriae that catch the ovum, then the wide ampulla and the narrow isthmus.
The uterine wall has three layers: a thin perimetrium, a thick muscular myometrium that contracts in labour, and the glandular endometrium that changes every cycle.
Each mammary gland has 15 to 20 lobes. Milk made in the alveoli flows through tubules, ducts, the ampulla and the lactiferous duct to the nipple.

body.en: The external genitalia include the mons pubis, labia majora, labia minora, hymen and clitoris. The mammary glands are paired; each has 15–20 mammary lobes containing clusters of alveoli that secrete milk. Milk flows through mammary tubules, mammary ducts, the mammary ampulla and the lactiferous duct to the nipple.
body.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಸ್ತನ ಗ್ರಂಥಿಯಲ್ಲಿ 15–20 ಹಾಲೆಗಳಿದ್ದು ಅಲ್ವಿಯೋಲೈಗಳು ಹಾಲನ್ನು ಸ್ರವಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಹಾಲು ನಾಳಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಮೊಲೆತೊಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಸಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Alveoli → tubules → ducts → ampulla → lactiferous duct

problem.en: Name the layer of the uterus involved in (a) menstruation and (b) the contractions of childbirth.

steps.en: The endometrium is the inner glandular layer that thickens each cycle and is shed during menstruation.
The myometrium is the thick layer of smooth muscle that contracts strongly during delivery.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Name the layer of the uterus involved in (a) menstruation and (b) the contractions of childbirth.
Team quiz. Each team discusses quietly and gives one answer.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡವೂ ಮೆಲ್ಲನೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದೇ ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಲಿ.
